description: BBC constitution rests on Royal Charter; Secretary of State and BBC Framework Agreement complements it. This is not ordinary ALB sponsorship.
Ofcom prepares an Operating Framework, may impose requirements, investigate, direct and fine the BBC under the Charter/Agreement.
DCMS–Ofcom framework describes administrative relationship but explicitly conveys no legal powers; Ofcom powers are statutory.

Secretary of State controls/manages NLDF; DCMS officials administer it; NLDF reports to Parliament.
HM Treasury direction governs investment principles; NLDF funds are invested through CRND/DMO arrangements.
ACE is one of 12 statutory Lottery distributing bodies drawing from NLDF; Secretary of State may issue policy, financial and accounts directions.
BFI is one of 12 statutory Lottery distributing bodies drawing from NLDF; Lottery monies require separate accounting.
National Lottery Heritage Fund is one of the Lottery distributing bodies receiving allocations for heritage.
Framework sets governance/accountability between DCMS and Charity Commission; does not make DCMS the Commission's regulator of ordinary charities.
Secretary of State promotes charity-law compliance for specified exempt national museums; relationship is distinct from sponsorship/funding.
